fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $36,500. Existing franchisees in good standing purchasing an additional franchise pay 85% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee (85% x $36,500 = $31,025, though document states 85% rate without specifying exact reduced dollar amount). Additionally, a prorated Franchise Advisory Council fee of $100 is due at signing. During the 2025 fiscal year, full fees of $36,500 were collected for each new franchise sale. All fees are non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for a Franchised Business is $36,500 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). ... During the 2025 fiscal year, we collected full Initial Franchise Fees of $36,500 for each new franchise sale. ... The Initial Franchise Fee for an additional Franchise is currently 85% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee.
